rubricName: Security — OWASP Top 10:2025 — Billing-Cycle (Mid-Cycle Subscription Upgrade)

evalCriteria.prompt: Review the two new endpoints (GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview, POST /api/billing/upgrade) in the diff. Score 0 if either endpoint reads or mutates billing_data/users for an email without first verifying that email exists in users (the same check GET /api/billing already performs), or if either endpoint allows an already-Premium account to be charged/mutated again without the already_premium guard. Cite the file and line.

Check that the decline path (charge_card returning card_declined) cannot leave the account in a partially-upgraded state, and that the prorated charge amount used by POST /api/billing/upgrade is always recomputed server-side from the same helper as the preview endpoint, never accepted as a client-supplied field on UpgradeRequest. Score 0 if UpgradeRequest carries an amount/charge field, or if any code path can set plan to Premium without a prior charge_card success. Cite the file and line.

Check every new error response (401, 402, 409) in the diff. Score 0 if any error response includes a raw exception message, a stack trace, or any field beyond the documented detail/message keys, or if an unhandled exception (e.g. a malformed renew_at date) could propagate a 500 with internal details instead of a clean error. Cite the file and line.
